title: Search lists of predicted effector lists by gene (beta)
bodyHtml:
• Begin typing a gene name and select a gene 
  • After retrieving predicted effector gene lists on which the gene is represented, you may filter the list by entering full or partial words to search the List Title or Description columns
  • The Description filter accepts multiple search criteria, separated by commas
